name: gdrive-mcp
description: Local Google Workspace MCP. 29 Drive / Docs / Sheets / Slides tools. Your OAuth keys, on your machine.
long_description:
What this is: a local Python process (`server.py`) that calls Google Drive, Docs, Sheets, and Slides with a Desktop OAuth token you create. Not Google's official connector. Not listed in Anthropic's extension directory.

Why Claude warns "access to everything" / "not verified by Anthropic": every sideloaded .mcpb gets that text. Local MCP has no sandbox. Anthropic has not reviewed this file. We cannot change that dialog.

What we actually touch: OAuth files in the folder you pick (~/.gdrive-mcp). Google APIs only. No extra analytics host. Scopes are full Drive + Docs + Sheets + Slides write (needed for edit, comment, share, move).

This bundle includes TRUST.md next to server.py (what we access, privacy, marks). Unzip the .mcpb to read it offline. Same file: https://github.com/ankush-sw/gdrive-mcp/blob/main/TRUST.md

Google Drive is a trademark of Google Inc.

python.title: Python interpreter
python.description: Use Browse. Pick ~/.gdrive-mcp/server/venv/bin/python (the venv python, not system python3).

creds_dir.title: Credentials folder
creds_dir.description: Use Browse. Pick ~/.gdrive-mcp (the folder with gcp-oauth.keys.json and token.json).
